# Daily Report — 2026-09-06

## Task Completed
Added `list_pa_breakdowns` and `get_pa_breakdown` tools for the `pa_breakdown` table.

PA breakdowns are dimension definitions (e.g. Priority, Category, Assignment Group) that
segment Performance Analytics indicator scores into categories.  The two tools allow
callers to discover all available breakdown dimensions and fetch a single breakdown by
sys_id or exact name.

**list_pa_breakdowns** — filters by name substring, active flag, source table, and field
name; results ordered by name; paginated with has_more/next_offset.

**get_pa_breakdown** — sys_id passthrough or name→sys_id auto-resolver; 404 and
empty-result guards; reference fields (table, calculated_from) normalised to display values.

Both tools registered in `system_administrator` and `full` packages.
